notes.title: New Update!
notes.notes:
Hello
We have made a small update with still a large update to come in late fall as we move to Version 2. It includes the following :
*added new visual movement cues to the movement system
*added new outline visual cue to the pickup system
*code enhancements and fixes

notes.title: Major Update!
notes.notes:
We have  updated FILE 9 and added the following:

Made environmental changes to areas

Added new weapon in Transport Tunnel

Main Terminal has several new interactive items

We have launched Drone Evasion and opened up  this simulation for you to explore and engage the enemies.
Within this simulation there are multiple weapons, interactive items and multiple enemies. This simulation is fairly large and we will be adding more content to it as well.

We have greatly improved the interactive objects with sound and feel.

There is more to come within the existing areas and the areas we have added as well.!

notes.title: Major Update and Pre - Launch of Newest Area!
notes.notes:
We have just updated FILE 9 and added the following:

Made environmental changes to a few of the areas

Added new weapon in Transport Tunnel

Main Terminal has several new interactive items

We have initially launched Drone Evasion and opened up the first Sector of this simulation for you to explore and engage the enemies.
Within this simulation there are multiple weapons, interactive items and multiple enemies. This simulation is fairly large and what has been opened to explore represents about 25% of the total game play area.

We have greatly improved the interactive objects with sound and feel.

We want to also let you know that now there are several areas running inside of FILE 9. We will continue to update and add the newer over the next few months. Please stay tuned to these as they will continue to be even more unique with environment and engagement!

notes.title: Next Simulation To Release!
notes.notes:
We will be releasing the next Simulation on Monday December the 19th 2016! This area will involve searching, avoiding enemies and using the assets available to you. You will need to rely on strategically moving through the area as carefully as possible to not get caught while trying to locate and retrieve the Cypress Assets.
This area will be available in the Infiltrate and Retrieve Simulation in File 9 and will have a new unique underground environment to maneuver through. 

Also we wanted to make sure you know again that we are not adding any additional charge as we do release each area.

notes.title: UPDATE
notes.notes: We have restructured FILE 9 to give it more depth and to fit the overall story much better. We are adding much more content within this restructuring to have a total of five areas that are unique. FILE 9 fits into a position of allowing for a fantastic VR experience for the main character of Lorna in a very good way with what is in the Cypress Inheritance story. FILE 9 represents a place that contains multiple simulations that  were designed by Alfred Cypress for training. Lorna being of the Cypress bloodline can utilize these to train and learn, as she has learned of her grandfather Alfred and the fact he has gone missing. Currently within the sub terminal where FILE 9 is located, there is one simulation that is available and is called Transport Tunnel Simulation. This  is a wave based simulation which was the original release of the game. It is complete and finished as it was at release. The additional areas will have different experiences, environments and features to make each stand alone. The next one being open inside will be Simulation: "Infiltrate and Retrieve". This simulation will require stealth and engagement. The others will vary from melee combat to adventure. We hope you enjoy FILE 9 and the VR experiences inside.
